label: Kpower
description: Adds a virtual power meter to your Karoo, estimating power from a physics model when you don't have a real power meter.
releaseNotes: Big update — your estimated power will change a bit (more accurate physics: real air temperature/pressure, accelerations, smoother 3s power, an FTP-based cap, and rolling resistance that adapts to the surface). What's new: keep several bikes and link each to a Karoo ride profile, so the right one is picked automatically when you switch profile; and an optional Comparison mode (off by default) that records your estimate — plus one real ANT+ power meter — as extra fields you can overlay in intervals.icu. Your existing setup keeps working; just review your bike's values after updating. Coming from a version older than 1.9.5? Uninstall the old one first.
